How Many Bought Backlinks Survive a Year? A 15,389-Link Audit
items.summary: How many bought backlinks still work a year later? We audited 15,389 Fiverr and Kwork links: only 3.7% are in Google's index, a third are dead, and 14.8% are blocked by noindex, robots.txt or canonical. Full data and charts: https://en.speedyindex.com/cases/marketplace-backlinks-one-year-later/
